pr48.title: fix(security): validate requirement lifecycle transitions (AZ-08)
pr48.body:
## Problem and behavior

AZ-08 allowed caller-supplied requirement statuses to be persisted by the real POST status route. The baseline reproduction accepted `SYNTHETIC_INVALID_STATUS` with 200. This candidate returns 422 without project/version/snapshot/business-audit changes, validates V1 transitions and optional aggregate version expectations, and retains the separate human-quorum APPROVED path.

**Base:** `bf5d617fa5bb76323714cc21cc20270acd826616`  
**Signed HEAD:** `e33f5ea7869db34654c831550c91029e2236b789` (SSH; GitHub verified valid)  
**Scope:** 13 files; 3 code/test files plus additive verification/decision documents, captured evidence and two current-state summaries.

## Runtime/API changes

- Exact six-value canonical status domain; no trimming/case conversion. Malformed fields 422; malformed/strict JSON 400; direct APPROVED 403; invalid transition/persisted lifecycle/version or stale optional expectedStateVersion 409; existing missing/ambiguous target 404/409.
- V1 permits existing UNDER_REVIEW/REJECTED/DEFERRED actions and VERIFIED compatibility. Same-state requests and reset-to-PROPOSED now 409; these are explicit new tactical rules for human review, not a pre-existing ratified matrix.
- `expectedStateVersion` is optional for legacy UI compatibility. Omission does not prevent every stale-client update. Success retains the existing transaction, one version/audit increment and adds policy-version provenance.
- No database/schema migration or new dependency. No application deployment. Ordinary valid calls remain LEGACY_LOCAL_UNSCOPED; **full authentication/tenant isolation is not implemented**.

## Verification and retained negative evidence

- Baseline actual-server test failed as expected: unknown status returned 200/persisted rather than 422. Original execution log is committed with hash-bound evidence.
- Candidate actual-server suite 105/105: full 36 status-pair matrix, malformed/case/whitespace/types, protected/escaped/duplicate-key values, persisted state/version problems, aliases/methods, unchanged denied memory/disk/audit, legitimate operations and restart.
- Existing actual-server requirement synchronization 18/18.
- Complete regression 66/66 suites, 1,636 observed named check outputs, 0 failures/skips.
- WBS zero drift, TypeScript and build PASS; existing large-chunk advisory only. Controlled documents 40/40 core + 29/29 additional + 11/11 focused; security integration 7/7. Complete suite includes perimeter 51/Vite 11/security 34/signoff/quorum/persistence.
- Eight candidate consistency checks PASS: exact tested source, evidence digests, unchanged WBS, preserved historical summary suffixes, links and allowed file scope.
- Independent fresh read-only investigator + one fresh candidate review; no concrete surviving AZ-08 bypass/regression found. Agent verification is separate from human approval.

Remote exact-HEAD CI: **ALL THREE JOBS SUCCESS** in [run 39199644427](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/actions/runs/39199644427), workflow head `e33f5ea7869db34654c831550c91029e2236b789`, completed `2026-10-19T04:33:20Z`.

| Job | Exact job | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quality & Build | [117889760822](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/actions/runs/39199644427/job/117889760822) | SUCCESS: WBS/typecheck/build |
| Controlled Docs | [117889760596](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/actions/runs/39199644427/job/117889760596) | SUCCESS: 40/40 core, 29/29 additional, 11/11 focused; snapshot mutation NONE |
| Complete Regression | [117889760763](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/actions/runs/39199644427/job/117889760763) | SUCCESS: 66/66 suites, 1,636 outputs, 0 failures/skips; AZ-08 105/105 |

Actual complete-regression log was independently fetched; summary at `2026-10-19T04:33:16Z`. Decoded log SHA-256: `6879af45983e23fadf571d4640f12b1d736cfdba4d263d31a48e36398b567a1f`.

## Closure and governance package

- [PR #47 closure](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/blob/e33f5ea7869db34654c831550c91029e2236b789/docs/07_verification/PR47_POST_MERGE_CLOSURE.md): actual review 5566722456 at 03:56:26Z matches final 0694072; human merged at 04:03:25Z into bf5d617; [exact-merge CI 39197583510](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/actions/runs/39197583510) all 3 jobs success, 65 suites/1531 outputs. Master reports protected; detailed settings read denied 403, so no historical protection-compliance assertion is made. The agent performed no merge.
- [PR #34 assessment](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/blob/e33f5ea7869db34654c831550c91029e2236b789/docs/06_planning/SECURITY_SPRINT2_GOVERNANCE_DECISIONS.md): open/unmerged, stale baseline; isolated candidate WBS renders but fails three current historical/count verifiers. DMK-209–214 remain unregistered. Proposed DMK-211 → DMK-209 sequencing requires a separate governed resolution; partial containment does not complete DMK-209.
- [S2-A decision package](https://github.com/Jeruzael/docmonstakrakin/blob/e33f5ea7869db34654c831550c91029e2236b789/docs/06_planning/SECURITY_S2A_IMPLEMENTATION_DECISION.md): operator selected Option 2 central principal/action/resource enforcement. Private SQLite, bounded async Argon2id, revocable sessions, separately reviewed loopback HTTPS and offline bootstrap/recovery are defaults/choices awaiting exact approval. **No S2-A implementation/activation authorization follows this PR.**

## Risks, reviewer focus and merge gate

Review the V1 transition table, retained VERIFIED and APPROVED-source rework compatibility, optional expected version, parser aliases and no-write assertions against the exact signed HEAD. The short requirements-register taxonomy omits VERIFIED while runtime/bootstrap/tests support it; this candidate preserves that behavior and records the discrepancy.

Unknown persisted statuses now require separate exact repair; no silent migration is performed. Older clients using repeated statuses/reset-to-PROPOSED/non-string justification must handle errors. Existing actor labels and 45 unscoped registrations remain risks.

Independent human review **REQUESTED** from `jianzhihuoxin` by `Jeruzael` at `2026-10-19T04:28:40Z` (timeline event `33610379751`). Actual human review is separately pending; no review was returned at request verification. Require all 3 CI jobs on this exact HEAD and an explicit human merge decision. **Do not merge automatically.** A safe rollback disables the endpoint or forward-fixes it; do not restore arbitrary-status acceptance.

Canonical WBS/history/trust/quorum, PR #34, operator credentials/state, 14 privileged denials, live Agent Center, live reconciliation, Gate 7 and release are unchanged. Store/KDF benchmark and runtime compatibility, browser transport, bootstrap/recovery, exact scope/acceptance and WBS prerequisites must be separately resolved before S2-A code starts.

- Synchronize `MASTER_WBS.md` (requires CI `wbs:check` confirmation).
- Preserve DMK-197, DMK-198, DMK-206, historical receipts and Gate 7.

## IMPORTANT: BLOCKED FROM MERGE UNTIL COMPATIBILITY REMEDIATION
**Do not merge as-is.** Historical verifiers bind to pre-registration WBS SHA-256 `53050b92...`; new candidate WBS SHA-256 is `e166f4679a71e8cec45ec5e0c5dc60f0b12c8ade0ada4696339662e258132273`. `verifyDmk208StatusAudit.ts` also expects 27 scoped items rather than 33. Historical DMK-197/DMK-196 verifiers are incompatible with changed WBS bytes. Required: forward-state registration receipt/validator, historical-snapshot-aware verification, negative tamper/missing-receipt tests, CI green, then independent review.

This PR is a **draft registration candidate**, not evidence of authenticated dual human sign-off or authorization to mutate runtime. No live reconciliation or release promotion was performed. Local board updates require merging, pulling and refresh/restart; runtime WorkItem materialization requires a separately approved exact reconciliation.

Related: #31, merged PR #32 and PR #33.
